scope: shared generic execution liveness; each PC reviews its own source composition
semantics: An unfilled ID-less RESERVED or UNKNOWN attempt with a target ending on a prior Pacific date does not force fresh forecasts in a later manual session into its cancellation path.
Retain both original records and full cash/share commitments. Existing independent fresh-capacity and submission checks still govern new intentions.
Known broker IDs, recorded fills, current/future target dates and missing or invalid target times retain normal reconciliation. No unknown acceptance or non-submission is inferred.
No automatic restart, session extension, manual-stop change, strategy/model change or private data mutation.
application: Verify each exact raw preimage first. Normalize matching private copies to LF, apply this LF patch, restore each final_newline_encoding, and verify after_sha256 before installation. Different compositions require a new reviewed adaptation; never replace a complete consumer. The added integration fixture depends on the existing adapted test_intraday_account_execution environment.

checks.full_integration: Run tests/test_intraday_historical_unknown_liveness.py with the adapted executor and existing account-execution, uncertain-commitment, interrupted-submission and cancellation fixtures; record actual results separately.

limitations: The common base may lack the adapted executor and fixture dependency tree. The portable checker proves patch integrity and predicate behavior; it does not claim full executor integration on an absent application.
This change does not resolve an uncertain historical broker submission. Definitive original order evidence remains required.
Publication, reviewed application installation, sealed runtime selection, loaded code and live behavior are separate facts.
